version.changelog: Sync existing infra403/opentwitter-2 from https://github.com/6551Team/opentwitter-mcp, main commit 8d69ca5e856f2026fde6b1903f6e06d63bab0770, directory openclaw-skill/opentwitter. Replace outdated SKILL.md with current upstream Twitter/X and meme evidence documentation; package.json remains byte-identical. Exact upstream source files only, excluding generated skill-card.md. Preserve display name Opentwitter, owner and slug. No examples executed.

llm.summary: This is mostly a documented Twitter/X API wrapper, but it includes deleted-tweet access and persistent account monitoring that deserve user review before installation.

dimensions.detail: Network access to ai.6551.io and a bearer token are proportionate for this API skill, but usernames, tweet IDs, searches, and watchlist changes are sent to a third-party service.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only markdown and a minimal package.json with no install scripts or dependencies; it requires curl and an OPENNEWS_TOKEN. The token acquisition link is documented as plain HTTP.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions are explicit curl examples rather than hidden execution, but the top-level purpose does not fully emphasize watchlist and real-time monitoring, and the artifact lacks privacy or acceptable-use limits for sensitive monitoring operations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No local persistence or privilege escalation was found, but the twitter_watch_add endpoint creates server-side persistent monitoring with many event types enabled by server defaults and no explicit confirmation or retention guidance in the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill coherently supports Twitter/X and meme-data retrieval via the 6551 API, but it also documents sensitive capabilities including follower/unfollower events, deleted tweets, KOL follower relationships, watchlists, and real-time monitored-account events.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you trust the 6551 service with your OPENNEWS_TOKEN and the Twitter/X accounts, searches, tweet IDs, and watchlists you query. Treat deleted-tweet retrieval and account monitoring as sensitive; use them only for legitimate, authorized purposes and review any server-side watch entries you create.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Partly supported: the manifest discloses follower events, deleted tweets, and KOL followers, but watchlist management and real-time subscriptions are only described deeper in the body and are not clearly surfaced in the package description.
[E1] expected: External POST requests to https://ai.6551.io are expected for a REST API skill and are not hidden exfiltration by themselves; the material issue is that some endpoints transmit sensitive monitoring targets and queries to a third party.
[SQP-2] expected: The deleted-tweet, follower-event, and watchlist features are documented and purpose-aligned, but the lack of privacy, authorization, and anti-harassment guidance makes them review-worthy.
